detail.longDescription: Vibe coding tools like Lovable and AI coding agents like Codex and Claude Code have totally changed the concept of building. You can now create a web app from a couple of text prompts, so can you do the same with a website? In short, yes. Though it's not quite as simple as that. The claim is that AI website builders can streamline everything from designing a site to creating the content, organizing it into the appropriate pages, and even getting it online.
